name: Vify Order Printer
summary: Shopify invoice and order printer app: customisable PDF invoices, packing slips, refunds, quotes and B2B invoices with VAT numbers, in several languages and currencies, with bulk printing and automatic invoice emails.
best_for: Shopify stores that want branded PDF invoices, packing slips and refunds emailed automatically with each order, including B2B and multi-language invoices
skip_if: you only print an occasional packing slip, which a free app covers, or you need a confirmed e-invoicing format before you know which plan includes it
honest_knock: Free only reaches your 50 latest orders and keeps Vify's branding; unlimited orders and automatic invoice emails start on the $10.99 Starter plan, and invoices from your own sender address on the $29.99 Premium plan. The listing advertises Peppol, ZUGFeRD and Factur-X e-invoicing and B2B VAT numbers without saying which plan includes them, and the developer API on the $69.99 plan is still listed as coming soon. We have not used the app ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month, or $109 a year
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-11 on the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/vify-order-printer, USD; the listing says recurring charges are billed every 30 days) Four plans. Free: freely customised templates, the 50 latest orders, PDF invoice download for customers on the storefront, auto-detected address formats, draft orders and 24/7 support. Starter is $10.99 a month or $109 a year (the listing says save 17%) and adds bulk processing, branding removal, unlimited orders, automatic PDF invoices by email, invoice editing, custom invoice numbers and language detection. Premium is $29.99 a month or $299 a year and adds more templates, custom invoices and quotes, a custom sender email, commercial invoices, product metafields and free customisation. Ultimate is $69.99 a month or $699 a year and adds priority live chat support and free custom templates tailored to your design; its developer API is listed as coming soon. Every paid plan has a 14-day free trial. The listing also says the app supports the European e-invoicing standards Peppol, ZUGFeRD and Factur-X and captures customer VAT numbers on B2B invoices, without saying which plan those belong to.

schema_offer.description: Starter, per month, or $109 a year; unlimited orders, bulk processing, branding removal and automatic PDF invoices by email; Free covers the 50 latest orders; Premium $29.99, Ultimate $69.99. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-11.

free_plan_evidence: Free: freely customised templates, the 50 latest orders, PDF invoice download for customers on the storefront, auto-detected address formats, draft orders and 24/7 support.

compare_with.name: Shopify Order Printer
compare_with.why: Shopify's own Order Printer app is free and listed for pick lists, invoices and packing slips. Vify is the step up when you need invoices emailed automatically, unlimited order history, B2B VAT numbers, commercial invoices or a European e-invoice format. If you only print a packing slip now and then, start with the free option.
